entities.name: Dzidra Uztupe-Karamiševa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dzidra Uztupe-Karamiševa was a Latvian basketball player and coach. During her career Uztupe-Karamiševa won three FIBA European Champions Cups and four Soviet League titles. She represented the Soviet Union national team and won four EuroBasket tournaments.
